summary:
[  edit  ]
The Curvesect  SOP  finds the intersections or the points of minimum distance between two or more faces (polygons, Bziers, and NURBS curves) or between faces and a polygonal or spline surface.

parameters.label: Face  Group
parameters.name: leftgroup
parameters.description: A subset of faces (NURBS, Bzier, polygons) to act upon. Accepts patterns, as described in  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Cutter  Group
parameters.name: rightgroup
parameters.description: A subset of faces or spline surfaces to intersect with. Accepts patterns, as described in  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Find All Intersections
parameters.name: xsect
parameters.description: Compute intersection points if the faces touch the cutter primitive. If the button is unchecked, only the point of minimum distance will be found. Currently, finding the minimum distance between a face and a surface is not available.

parameters.label: Tolerance
parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: Determines the precision of the intersection.

parameters.label: Method
parameters.name: method
parameters.description: ⊞  - Choose between 'Cut' or 'Extract' operations.

parameters.label: Left Face Pieces
parameters.name: left
parameters.description: ⊞  - Choose what parts of the left faces to keep:

parameters.label: Keep All
parameters.name: lkeepall
parameters.description: All the face segments generated by the intersection(s).

parameters.label: Keep Odd-numbered Ones
parameters.name: lkeepodd
parameters.description: The odd face segments: 1, 3, 5...

parameters.label: Keep Even-numbered Ones
parameters.name: lkeepeven
parameters.description: The even face segments: 0, 2, 4...

parameters.label: Keep None
parameters.name: lkeepnone

parameters.name: right

parameters.label: Left Input
parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Extract from the left input faces.

parameters.label: Right Input

parameters.label: Extract  Point
parameters.name: extractpt
parameters.description: If the right input is a surface, choose between point and isoparm extraction; only points are extracted if the right input is a face.

parameters.label: Keep Original
parameters.name: keeporiginal
parameters.description: When using Extract method, turning this on will keep the original geometry connected to the first input (input0).

parameters.label: Method: Cut. For the Left Face, select Keep Odd
parameters.description: numbered Ones.

parameters.label: Place a new Font  SOP  and then a Circle  SOP . Circle
parameters.name: SOP
parameters.description: Type: NURBS, Radius 0.1, 0.1; Centre -3, 0.3, 0.2. Font  SOP  - Text: "Creep Along Me".

parameters.label: As you change the Circle's X value from
parameters.description: 3.0 to 3.0, you will notice that a number of points will creep along the paths of the curves within the text. Using a Copy  SOP  to copy geometry to each of these points gives you a simple way of creating an irregular "flocking behaviour" along predetermined paths. This works, because as the circle moves above the curves in the text, the points in the curves that are closest to the circle move also.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: The Graphics Processing Unit. This is the high
parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.
